title: NV2A SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM dispatch oracle (v0.2 — PASS_THROUGH + PROGRAM_NONE + V0/DIFFUSE bisect; ships as expected_fail Metal pending task #18 investigation)
purpose: 4x3 grid (12 cells) exercising 2 of the 19 NV2A texture-shader-stage modes at stage 0 plus a 3rd-row combiner-A=V0 bisect cell. Row 0 (4 cells): SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM stage0 = PASS_THROUGH (0x04) + combiner ICW A_SOURCE = T0 (0x8); TEXCOORD0 set to (R,G,B,1) per cell; expected RED/GREEN/BLUE/WHITE via t0 = pT0 -> R0 -> fragColor. Row 1 (4 cells): SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM stage0 = PROGRAM_NONE (0x00) + combiner ICW A_SOURCE = T0; TEXCOORD0 mirrors row 0; t0 = (0,0,0,1) regardless of input so all 4 cells render BLACK. Row 2 (4 cells, v0.2 bisect): SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM stage0 = PROGRAM_NONE (0x00) + combiner ICW A_SOURCE = V0 (0x4, DIFFUSE); per-cell DIFFUSE attribute = (R,G,B,1) so the combiner reads v0 directly and routes A -> R0 -> fragColor, bypassing the t0 / pT0 path entirely; expected RED/GREEN/BLUE/WHITE. Identical TEXCOORD0 across all 3 rows + identical SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM mode dispatch between rows 1 and 2 isolates the bisect: if row 2 renders correctly while row 0 stays BLACK, the failure localizes to the renderer's PASS_THROUGH dispatch (the t0 / pT0 chain) and the XBE-side combiner / vertex-attrib / state-machine plumbing is proven sound. If row 2 also fails, the failure is broader (combiner program never reaches the fragment stage, or every per-cell draw is silently dropped). Stage 0 bound for all 12 cells to a 4x4 magenta dummy texture so the renderer does not override SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM to NONE due to a disabled stage (psh.c:142-148). The texture is never sampled by either PASS_THROUGH or NONE; any accidental sample reaching fragColor would paint row 0 MAGENTA instead of the target colors. v0.2 catches: (a) SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM 5-bit-per-stage field mis-decoded; (b) PASS_THROUGH collapsed to NONE (row 0 BLACK); (c) NONE collapsed to PASS_THROUGH (row 1 colored); (d) TEXCOORD0 attribute interpolation broken (row 0 uniform color); (e) dummy texture sample leaking into the combiner (row 0 MAGENTA); (f) v0.2 bisect — renderer-side PASS_THROUGH/t0-path bug isolated from XBE-side combiner / state-machine bug via row 2's DIFFUSE-source bypass. v0.3 will expand to the remaining 17 modes; multi-stage chaining (BUMPENVMAP*, DOT_*, DPNDNT_*, DOTPRODUCT) requires inter-stage infrastructure deferred to v0.4+.
expected_fail_notes: Metal ships as expected_fail pending task #18 root-cause investigation. v0.2 baseline (benchmark-runs/20260522T075639Z-task18-texture-shader-stages-metal-v0.2-baseline/) ran 3 full XBE cycles (~14s each); the 8 XBE-active host-capture frames at indices 0116-0118, 0183-0184, 0248-0250 are all pure (0,0,0,0) -- not just rows 0 and 1 but ALSO row 2 (the V0/DIFFUSE-source bisect cells at y=320..479) rendered BLACK. Per-row stats archived at key-evidence/per-row-stats.md. v0.2 BISECT VERDICT (refined per Codex 2026-05-22 findings 1+2): the PASS_THROUGH-SPECIFIC reading of v0.1 hypothesis 1 (NV_PGRAPH_SHADERPROG dirty-state propagation tied to mode 4) is RULED OUT -- row 2 keeps SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM=PROGRAM_NONE for all 4 cells (no inter-cell change) yet still fails, so a SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM-mode-specific dirty-state bug cannot explain row 2's failure. The BROADER reading -- 'any SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM override under xbed_load_textured_shaders() is not being honored' -- REMAINS LIVE and needs the v0.3 control-row bisect or a per-draw pipeline-key dump to confirm or rule out. Two surviving candidates after Codex finding 2: (a, renamed v0.1 candidate 3) state-machine interaction between xbed_load_textured_shaders Cg-emitted setup and the XBE's per-cell overrides on Metal; the dashboard renders correctly and combiner-basic (which uses xbed_load_default_shaders, no texturing) PASSes on Metal in the same harness session, but every XBE draw here fails. Likely interaction points: (a.i) Cg's pre-set SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM=2D_PROJECTIVE for stage 0 in xbed_tex_ps.inl is overridden per-cell but Metal's texture-state cache / dirty-bit chain may not invalidate the right things; (a.ii) textured VS has 3 input attributes vs default VS's 2 -- the vertex descriptor / uniform_attrs recomputation may not be picking up TEXCOORD0 (slot 9) as expected; (a.iii) bind_dummy_stage0's tex bind interacts with per-cell SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM override in a way that silently drops the draw on Metal. (b, NEW per Codex 2026-05-22 finding 2) combiner-rewrite ignored under textured-shader state: the only intentional row1->row2 delta is the second program_combiners_with_a_source() call switching ICW A_SOURCE from T0 (0x8) to V0 (0x4). If that combiner update is silently dropped under textured-shader state, row 2's BLACK output is equally explained by row 1's residual A_SOURCE=T0 config still in effect (combined with t0=(0,0,0,1) from NONE -> R0=0 -> BLACK). Distinct from (a): even if SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM overrides ARE honored, the combiner override may not be. ALSO IDENTIFIED (separate bug, not the task #18 root cause but real -- Codex 2026-05-22 independently verified): reading psh.c:142-148 + pgraph.h:330 (pgraph_is_texture_stage_active) shows that the fork-local gate added in commit 046160d04d 'Fix Metal boot and texture stability canaries' (2026-05-04) clears state->shader_stage_program stage-0 bits when !enabled, and pgraph_is_texture_stage_active returns false for mode == 4 (PASS_THROUGH). So PASS_THROUGH on an enabled stage gets degraded to NONE in the generated shader. This matches the v0.1 shader-dump finding (no `vec4 t0 = pT0;` signature) and would explain row 0's BLACK output -- but v0.2 shows row 2 also fails, so this psh.c bug alone is insufficient to explain task #18. It remains a real PASS_THROUGH-path bug worth a separate fix slice (proposed: exempt NONE and PASS_THROUGH from the zeroing gate; shared GL+Metal code; requires Metal boot-animation regression test). Next-session bisect (proposed): (1) add a v0.3 control row that uses xbed_load_default_shaders (no texturing) but still issues per-cell SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM writes -- isolates candidate (a) from the broader override-not-honored case; (2) in parallel, instrument the row1->row2 combiner A_SOURCE switch directly with a sentinel combiner config that would produce a deterministic non-black output IF the combiner update is honored -- isolates candidate (b); (3) alternatively, dump the Metal pipeline cache key per draw via XEMU_METAL_DIAG_ATTRIB_DUMP to see whether the XBE's per-cell pipelines are even being built. GL renderer leg is NOT in the rotation: the harness's GL-side capture path uses sidecar window screencapture which cannot reliably land a deterministic frame in the XBE's 5-second render window; the GL leg is excluded from expected_fail_renderers because the harness will report no-screenshot-captured rather than a comparable diff result. See decision-log 2026-05-22 cycle 7 + handoff.md.
